QuestInfo.name: [Solatum] Of Two Kinds
QuestInfo.0: At Prince Carlisle's request to protect the Order of Thenia, you head to #bSolatum Valley#k. Talk to Neinheart to travel there.
QuestInfo.1: There are fallen #bbelievers#k of Thenia all around... You should check the entrance to the temple next.
QuestInfo.2: It was a massacre. The believers had been slain with common blades, but the soldiers from Cernium had been killed with something far more massive... But what led to these deaths?
